# Replace

Replaces every occurrence of one piece of text with another.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Replace(text, oldValue, newValue)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to search. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |
| `oldValue` | string | The text to find. Matching is exact: case and every character count. The empty string is a runtime error, and so is null, which is read as the empty string. |
| `newValue` | string | The text to put in place of each occurrence. Null is read as the empty string, which removes each occurrence. |

## Returns

String. The text with each occurrence of oldValue, found from left to right without overlapping, replaced by newValue; the text unchanged when oldValue does not occur in it. Never null.

## Example

`Replace("a-b-c", "-", "+")` returns `"a+b+c"`.
